source: Owner asked (7 Nov) for a reel saying Black Friday is a bigger sale than Diwali. Sources checked 7 Nov: GoKwik Wrapped 2025 (released 30 Dec 2025, via BW Retail World and MediaNews4U): on GoKwik's D2C network, Black Friday 28 Nov 2025 had the most orders of the whole year, above Diwali and Dussehra. Unicommerce (PTI, 1 Dec 2025): Black Friday week order volume up about 27% vs the 2024 sale window. Black Friday 2026 = Fri 27 Nov. Replaces the old CASE #20 SALE script (owner said it gave no value).
